title: A finite unramified morphism is etale locally on the base a finite disjoint union of closed immersions
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism], and let $x\in X$. Then there are an etale morphism $g:U\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a point $u\in U$ with $g(u)=x$ such that the induced map of residue fields $\kappa(x)\to\kappa(u)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is an isomorphism, a finite set $J$ and pairwise disjoint open and closed subschemes $V_j\subseteq Y\times_XU$ ($j\in J$) of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] whose union is $Y\times_XU$, such that for every $j\in J$ the composite $V_j\hookrightarrow Y\times_XU\xrightarrow{\mathrm{pr}_2}U$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion].
